verdict.rationale: An audit trail is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a change log showing who changed what and when across the ledger. The closest item is that editing a manual journal entry creates a reversing entry plus a new entry, but that is adjacent ledger-immutability behavior, not a user-attributed, timestamped audit trail across the whole ledger.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
